name: fractal-agentic
description: Progressive one-boss discovery, /orchestrate delivery runtime, and vendored skills for coding agents. Capability lanes, verify, ship|fix-first|rethink review.

interface.longDescription: Fractal Agentic uses a compact startup router to select exactly one of seven nested boss playbooks, then runs boss-orchestration: capability routing, primary verification, and ship|fix-first|rethink review. Host-agnostic with optional hooks and multi-host install.
defaultPrompt: Use the startup router, read exactly one boss playbook, then /orchestrate this change.
Activate the Svelte Boss and orchestrate this feature end-to-end.
Preflight Fractal Agentic custom agents, route implementation, and require a fresh review before done.
